mapper.select: SELECT module.name AS name, count( endpoint.id ) AS total FROM monitor_module module LEFT JOIN monitor_endpoint endpoint ON module.id = endpoint.module_id GROUP BY module.id
SELECT DISTINCT asset.* FROM monitor_module mm RIGHT JOIN monitor_endpoint me ON mm.id = me.module_id RIGHT JOIN asset_asset asset ON me.asset_id = asset.id WHERE mm.id = #{moduleId}

SELECT DISTINCT dc.* FROM monitor_module mm RIGHT JOIN monitor_endpoint me ON mm.id = me.module_id RIGHT JOIN asset_asset asset ON me.asset_id = asset.id RIGHT JOIN dc dc ON asset.dc_id = dc.id WHERE mm.id = #{moduleId}
SELECT IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT mm.name ), '') FROM monitor_endpoint me LEFT JOIN monitor_module mm ON me.module_id = mm.id WHERE me.asset_id = #{assetId}
